questions.question: At a fun day 3/5 of 360 learners run races and 1/4 of the runners enter the long race. How many enter the long race? Show your working.
A budget of R1 200 is split 40% food, 25% prizes and the rest decorations. Find each amount and check your answer.
questions.expected_answer: Food R480, prizes R300, decorations 35% = R420. Check: R480 + R300 + R420 = R1 200.

questions.question: How many tables can be served from 20 l of juice if each table needs 2 1/2 l? Is this grouping or sharing?
questions.expected_answer: 20 ÷ 2 1/2 = 8 tables (check 8 × 2 1/2 = 20). It is grouping, because the size of each portion is known and the number of portions is wanted.
